sum: Vogenx, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage drug development company that develops therapeutics for metabolic including post-bariatric hypoglycemia, or PBH, and gastroparesis. Its products include drugs, such as Mizagliflozin and VGX-2857. It also offers VGX-001, a human monoclonal antibody for the treatment of type 1 diabetes (T1D). It caters to healthcare providers, physicians and third-party payors in the United States. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Raleigh, North Carolina.
